item.title: Drive-By Truckers’ Patterson Hood talks new album
item.description: Drive-By Truckers’ Patterson Hood reflects on his new album, songwriting and a new generation of artists ahead of Stuart’s show.

item.title: Pieces of LGBTQ Ohio history were at risk of disappearing. A digitization effort is rescuing them
item.description: The effort includes 160 audio and visual tapes in a collection of analog media at Ohio History Connection chronicling LBGTQ history.

item.title: Nearly half of Ohioans age 45 to 54 are behind on screenings for 'one of the most preventable cancers'
item.description: Colorectal cancer is one of the top causes of cancer deaths. More than 2,000 people died from colorectal cancer in Ohio in 2022.

item.title: CrossFit isn’t just for the gym-obsessed. In Ohio, it’s reaching incarcerated youth
item.description: Officials said the CrossFit curriculum allowed for young people involved in the system to bond with adults in a different way.

item.title: OU Alumna to screen Vietnam War films at Athena Cinema
item.description: OU alumna Robin Smith screens two films on her father, a Vietnam MIA, at the Athena Cinema March 29 as part of Ohio Goes to The Movies.

item.title: A teenager faces charges in an accident that killed a Wellston police officer
item.description: A teenager has been charged with aggravated vehicular homicide following a crash last year that killed an off-duty Wellston police officer.

item.title: Now Playing : Outer space, inner turmoil - WOUB Public Media
item.description: Three sci-fi films—"Silent Running", "Sunshine", and "Moon"—explore isolation, morality, and the psychological toll of life in outer space.

item.title: A federal judge finds President Trump violated free speech by ordering NPR and PBS be defunded
item.description: A federal judge has knocked down the core of President Trump's executive order barring federal funding for NPR and PBS.

item.title: The US Supreme Court's conversion therapy ruling prompts Columbus and other Ohio cities to review bans
item.description: Leaders are all reviewing a U.S. Supreme Court ruling Tuesday that struck down a state law in Colorado banning conversion therapy on minors.

item.title: ACLU of Ohio finds more police departments and sheriffs are signing agreements with ICE
item.description: Contracts between Ohio police departments and sheriff's offices with ICE have increased since President Trump's second term in office began.

item.title: Ohio colleges' compliance with the state's ban on DEI is being called into question
item.description: SB 1 banned public universities from promoting DEI, limited what they could say about issues and required "intellectual diversity."

item.title: 'All Things Equal' stages RBG’s life in Marietta
item.description: Michelle Azar stars as Ruth Bader Ginsburg in All Things Equal, a one-woman play coming to Peoples Bank Theatre in Marietta April 3.

item.title: Athens city officials made their case for a proposed income tax increase at a town hall meeting
item.description: Athens officials say they got the message residents were sending when a proposed income tax increase last year was soundly defeated.

item.title: Over 200 films to be screened at 53rd AIFVF April 13 - 16
item.description: Athens International Film + Video Festival (AIFVF) returns April 13–19 with over 200 films from more than 60 countries.

item.title: Medication assisted treatment is a proven method to curb addiction. New research out of Ohio University finds one obvious place its not offered
item.description: "We really need to normalize addiction treatment as just part of healthcare and not make it more difficult and put more barriers in place."
